subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: Must `getPublishedDisplayManifest` provide a complete GitHub-backed catalog synchronously, or may the profile render a bounded preview with an explicit paged or deferred catalog path?
rationale: The remaining work is not a mechanical bound: choosing a cap or pagination changes the completeness and rendering contract for GitHub-backed publisher profiles.

options.title: Keep complete synchronous catalog
options.body: Preserve the existing complete-manifest contract and add an explicitly bounded or precomputed representation that proves the database read remains safe.

options.title: Adopt bounded preview plus pagination
options.body: Render a bounded initial manifest and move complete catalog access to the existing paged path with clear UI and compatibility coverage.

options.title: Track a separate manifest redesign
options.body: Leave the current behavior temporarily and split the contract decision into a narrow follow-up before changing this query.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded preview plus pagination
recommendation.body: Render a bounded initial manifest and move complete catalog access to the existing paged path with clear UI and compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and documented the staged publisher-read design, including the remaining contract boundary.
